briefdescription.para: A basic block represents a single entry single exit section of code.

detaileddescription.para: Basic blocks contain a list of instructions which form the body of the block.
Basic blocks belong to functions. They have the type of label.
Basic blocks are themselves values. However, the C API models them as LLVMBasicBlockRef.
